reason: $59 a month is a real chunk on my budget when the library, parks and CoCo's already fill most of our weeks. It looks like CoCo's with nicer decor, and I'd only come once the place is open and I've seen it.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I can't see why it's worth paying a monthly fee when I have cheaper options already.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial day for my moms group, or a clearly lower monthly price (about $30-35) and proof it's quieter and different from CoCo's.
